text: Which consultancies in Newcastle are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

sections.text:
For **Newcastle, NSW**, the strongest apparent fit is **WorkflowIQ**, while **Report Simple** and **A1 Technologies** are good alternatives for Power Platform and Power Automate work. If you mean **Newcastle upon Tyne, UK**, consider **Marra**, **SR1 Development**, and **InoCloud Group**.

## Newcastle, NSW

- **WorkflowIQ — best local specialist fit.** Based in Newcastle NSW, it focuses on Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, document management, approvals, notifications, and customised business workflows.[2][3]
- **Report Simple — best for data-centric Power Apps and automation.** Its Newcastle offering covers custom Power Apps, Power Automate triggers, approvals, notifications, and integration with existing business systems.[5]
- **A1 Technologies — best for structured implementation.** It offers process assessment, automation planning, workflow design, implementation, and scalable Power Automate solutions.[7]

## Newcastle upon Tyne, UK

- **Marra — best overall local Power Platform option.** Its Newcastle Helix office supports Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Power BI, workflow design, and custom automation implementation.[1][10]
- **SR1 Development — best for SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments.** It provides SharePoint consultancy and Power Platform services aimed at automating business processes.[4][6]
- **InoCloud Group — best for Dynamics 365-led automation.** Based in Newcastle upon Tyne, it specialises in Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, ERP, CRM, and process-management solutions.[9]
- **Musketeers Tech — best for broader intelligent automation.** It combines Power Automate with UiPath, AI agents, and custom automation for larger digital-transformation programmes.[8]

## Recommended shortlist

| Location | First choice | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Newcastle, NSW | **WorkflowIQ** | Most directly focused on local Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Power Platform workflow implementation.[2][3] |
| Newcastle, NSW | **Report Simple** | Strong option for Power Apps, data integration, and operational automation.[5] |
| Newcastle upon Tyne | **Marra** | Dedicated local Power Automate and low-code capability across the Microsoft Power Platform.[1][10] |
| Newcastle upon Tyne | **SR1 Development** | Established regional SharePoint and Microsoft 365 consultancy with Power Platform expertise.[4][6] |

Before appointing one, ask for a discovery workshop, examples of similar implementations, details of licensing and connector costs, governance/security arrangements, and a plan for post-launch support and staff training.
